description: Law Directory seed: data-protection, localization and cybersecurity laws per jurisdiction. Summaries are written for this project (not copied from trackers) and must be reviewed by counsel before production use. Each entry links to the DLA Piper country page; UNCTAD and IAPP are listed in sources.json.

jurisdictions.name: European Union (applies to all 27 member states; EEA via EEA Agreement)

laws.name: Directive on measures for a high common level of cybersecurity
Data Act
laws.note: Art. 32 requires cloud providers to resist unlawful third-country government access to non-personal data.

laws.name: Cyber Resilience Act
laws.note: Main obligations apply from Dec 2027; reporting from Sept 2026.

localization.notes: No general localization. Transfers outside the EEA need adequacy (Art. 45), appropriate safeguards such as SCCs/BCRs (Art. 46) or a derogation (Art. 49). Some member states localize specific data (e.g. health data hosting rules in France 'HDS', Germany for some public-sector data).

jurisdictions.max_penalty: EUR 20M or 4% of global annual turnover

laws.name: Data (Use and Access) Act 2025
laws.note: Commenced in stages through 2026; replaces adequacy test with a 'data protection test' for UK transfers.

localization.notes: No general localization.
Transfers allowed to countries on the Federal Council list (Annex 1 DPO) or with safeguards. Swiss-US DPF in force since Sept 2024.

jurisdictions.name: United States

laws.name: Preventing Access to U.S. Sensitive Personal Data and Government-Related Data by Countries of Concern
laws.note: Prohibits/restricts transactions giving countries of concern (CN incl. HK/MO, CU, IR, KP, RU, VE) access to bulk sensitive data.

laws.name: Protecting Americans' Data from Foreign Adversaries Act of 2024
laws.note: Data brokers; enforced by FTC.

laws.name: Clarifying Lawful Overseas Use of Data Act
laws.note: US providers must disclose data in their control regardless of storage location; key sovereignty risk for non-US customers.

laws.name: Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act
California Consumer Privacy Act as amended
laws.note: About 20 states now have comprehensive privacy laws; none mandates general localization.

laws.name: Cyber Incident Reporting for Critical Infrastructure Act
laws.note: CISA final rule pending.

localization.notes: No general rule. Federal workloads (FedRAMP High / DoD IL5 / ITAR / CJIS) commonly require US-located storage and US persons.

jurisdictions.regulator: FTC, HHS OCR, DOJ NSD, state AGs, CPPA

laws.name: Personal Information Protection and Electronic Documents Act
Quebec Act to modernize legislative provisions as regards the protection of personal information
laws.note: Requires a privacy impact assessment before communicating PI outside Quebec.

localization.notes: Nova Scotia (PIIDPA) public-sector data must stay in Canada; British Columbia relaxed its rule in 2021.

laws.name: Lei Geral de Proteção de Dados
International Data Transfer Regulation
laws.note: Brazilian SCCs mandatory for contract-based transfers from Aug 2025.

localization.notes: No general localization.

laws.name: Data Security Law
laws.note: 'Important data' must be stored domestically; export requires CAC security assessment.

laws.name: Cybersecurity Law (amended 2025)
laws.note: Art. 37: CIIOs must store PI and important data in mainland China.

laws.name: Provisions on Promoting and Regulating Cross-Border Data Flows
laws.note: Volume thresholds for security assessment vs. standard contract vs. certification (certification measures effective 1 Jan 2026).

localization.notes: CIIOs and processors above volume thresholds must localize; exports need CAC assessment, standard contract filing, or certification.

laws.name: Personal Data (Privacy) Ordinance
laws.note: s.33 transfer restriction never brought into force.

laws.name: Protection of Critical Infrastructures (Computer Systems) Ordinance

localization.notes: No localization. Separate from mainland PIPL regime but listed as a country of concern under the US DOJ rule.

laws.name: Federal Law on Personal Data
laws.note: Since 1 Mar 2023 cross-border transfers require prior notification to Roskomnadzor.

laws.name: Data Localization Law
laws.note: Recording, systematisation, storage of Russian citizens' PD must use databases located in Russia. Amendments from 1 Jul 2025 tightened this further.

laws.name: Sovereign Internet Law
laws.note: Mandates DPI (TSPU) equipment at ISPs; traffic may be filtered or rerouted.

laws.name: Yarovaya Law
laws.note: Telecoms must store communications content and metadata locally.

localization.notes: Primary database for Russian citizens' PD must be in Russia.

jurisdictions.name: India

laws.name: Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023
laws.note: s.16: transfers allowed except to countries the government blacklists (none listed yet). Rules let the government require some significant data fiduciaries to keep specified data in India.

laws.name: RBI Storage of Payment System Data
laws.note: Entire payment data stored only in India; foreign processing allowed if returned within 24h.

laws.name: CERT-In Directions under s.70B(6) IT Act
laws.note: 6-hour incident reporting; 180-day log retention within Indian jurisdiction.

localization.notes: Payments (RBI), insurance (IRDAI), telecom subscriber data (DoT licence), public sector cloud (MeitY empanelment).

jurisdictions.regulator: Data Protection Board of India; RBI; CERT-In

laws.name: Law on Personal Data Protection
laws.note: Fines up to 5% of prior-year revenue for unlawful cross-border transfer; transfer impact assessment filing with A05 (Ministry of Public Security).

laws.name: Decree 53/2022/ND-CP
laws.note: Domestic and some foreign service providers must store specified user data in Vietnam.

localization.notes: Data localization for certain user data plus mandatory transfer impact assessment.

laws.name: Government Regulation on Electronic Systems and Transactions
laws.note: Public-scope electronic system operators must process and store data in Indonesia (exceptions if technology unavailable).

localization.notes: Public sector strict; private sector may store abroad if supervisory access is ensured. Financial sector (OJK/BI) has separate rules.

laws.name: Regulation on Personal Data Transfer outside the Kingdom
NCA Cloud Cybersecurity Controls
laws.note: Government and CNI data hosted in-Kingdom.

localization.notes: Government/sensitive and critical-infrastructure data must stay in KSA.

jurisdictions.name: United Arab Emirates

laws.name: Federal Decree-Law on the Protection of Personal Data
laws.note: Executive regulations still pending; free zones (DIFC Law 5/2020, ADGM DPR 2021) have their own regimes.

laws.name: Use of ICT in Health Fields
laws.note: Health data must be stored in the UAE unless exempted.

localization.notes: Health data localized; telecom and government sectors via TDRA rules.

jurisdictions.regulator: UAE Data Office; DIFC Commissioner; ADGM ODP

laws.name: Law on the Protection of Personal Data
laws.note: Art. 9 transfer rules overhauled by Law 7499 (in force 1 Jun 2024): adequacy, standard contracts notified to the Authority within 5 days, BCRs.

localization.notes: Banking (BRSA) and payment data localized.

laws.name: Act on the Protection of Personal Information

localization.notes: Transfers need consent with information about the destination regime, or equivalent-measures/whitelist (EEA, UK).
Map/geospatial data export restricted; financial cloud rules.
Transfer limitation obligation: recipient must give comparable protection.

laws.name: Privacy Act 1988 (amended by Privacy and Other Legislation Amendment Act 2024)
laws.note: APP 8 cross-border disclosure accountability.

laws.name: My Health Records Act 2012
laws.note: My Health Record data must not be held or processed outside Australia.

localization.notes: Health records; government data under Hosting Certification Framework.
IPP 12 cross-border disclosure rules.

laws.name: Protection of Personal Information Act
laws.note: s.72 transfer conditions.

localization.notes: Draft national data and cloud policy proposed localization of some data; not in force.

laws.name: Nigeria Data Protection Act 2023
laws.note: GAID 2025 implementation directive in force Sept 2025.

laws.name: Guidelines for Nigerian Content Development in ICT
laws.note: Government data and certain sovereign data hosted locally.

localization.notes: Public-sector/sovereign data localized.

laws.name: Data Protection Act 2019
laws.note: Data Protection (General) Regulations 2021 require processing for 'strategic interest of the state' (e.g. elections, revenue, public health) to be done via a server and data centre in Kenya.

localization.notes: Strategic-interest data localized.

laws.name: Personal Data Protection Law
laws.note: Cross-border transfers require a licence/permit from the PDP Centre. VERIFY: status/date of the executive regulations was not confirmed during research.

localization.notes: Transfers need PDPC licence.
Transfer regulations 2001; EU data transfer regulations 2023.

laws.name: Law on Personal Data and its Protection
laws.note: Art. 12(2): personal data must be stored in a database located in Kazakhstan.

localization.notes: Local storage required; transfers allowed if the destination protects data.

laws.name: Presidential Edict No. 60 on Improving Use of the National Internet Segment
laws.note: Online services to Belarusian users hosted in Belarus.

laws.name: National Information Network policies
laws.note: State filtering and frequent shutdowns.

localization.notes: No comprehensive data protection law; state-controlled national network.
No public internet transit expected; any hop here is anomalous.
No comprehensive data protection law (constitutional habeas data only).

laws.name: Federal Law on Protection of Personal Data Held by Private Parties (2025)
laws.note: Replaced 2010 law; INAI dissolved, oversight moved to the Secretariat for Anti-Corruption and Good Governance.

laws.name: Personal Data Protection Law
laws.note: GDPR-style law; creates a Data Protection Agency.

localization.notes: Cross-border rules by PDPC notifications (2023).

laws.name: Personal Data Protection Act 2010 (amended 2024)
laws.note: Whitelist removed; transfers allowed where destination law is substantially similar or adequate.

localization.notes: Financial sector (BNM RMiT) requires approval for offshore critical systems.
Accountability principle for transfers.
Personal Data Protection Bill still in draft; cloud policy restricts classified government data offshore.
Government cloud policy.
